title: Walk-based channel attribution and exact double counting under nonnegative impact feedback
checked_scope: Impact-only linear systems with entrywise nonnegative B,g,ℓ and spectral radius ρ(B)<1; coordinate equation removal.
significance: Proves a general positive-feedback channel attribution theorem: removal contrasts count each walk once per visited channel, while Shapley attribution divides each walk among its distinct channels.
author: /root/new200_e
